summary: SiteDocument represents a document attached to a site, containing site-related information and identifiers.
purpose: To store and reference documents associated with a particular site within the system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument objects are used for linking and referencing documents with sites.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin page provides administrative staff a welcome screen with contextual information, last login, and access to site and discipline filters for reviewing employment applications.
purpose: To welcome staff admins and enable them to view and filter student employment applications with site and discipline parameters.

workflows.name: View Submitted Employment Applications
steps: Login and arrive at WelcomeStaffAdmin page
Select site and discipline filters
Specify start and end date
Show withdrawn applications if desired
Click Refresh to update the view
Review submitted applications in grid

business_rules: Applications are filtered by site, discipline, and date.
validations: StartDate and EndDate are required fields.
StartDate and EndDate must match valid date formats.
StartDate must not be after EndDate.
conditions: Page displays warning/error panels if issues arise.
WithdrawnDate is displayed if application is withdrawn.
system_behavior: Grid displays filtered student employment applications.
Refresh button rebinds data to the grid.
Dropdowns for site and discipline are populated from agency and discipline lists.
Last login is displayed if available.
JavaScript is used to enhance UI functionality.
content_gaps: No explicit business rules for user permissions or grid sorting found.
Limited detail on error/warning handling and grid fields.

summary: ServiceCode represents a coded classification for services, organized by category and containing multilingual support.
purpose: To classify and provide metadata for services within the application, including sorting, notes, and multilingual names.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeListAll with session
Return all service codes with localization

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with session and course ID
Return service codes relevant to course

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Timetable
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and timetable ID
Return service codes relevant to timetable

business_rules: If user session is in alt language, use NameAlt and NotesAlt.
conditions: If UseAltLanguageFields is set for user session, Name and Notes are replaced with multilingual alternatives.
system_behavior: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, and ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID return lists of ServiceCode objects, localized as needed.
content_gaps: No details for CodeCategory entity or logic for NotesAlt.

summary: SiteProfileHistory tracks changes to the site profile, recording user actions, field changes, and metadata for audit purposes.
purpose: To provide an audit trail for all edits and actions on site profiles.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: User invokes SiteProfileHistorySearch with site ID and session agency ID
Stored procedure returns history records
UI component binds results to grid

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is enabled, fields use alternate language values.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted: composite string of agency and user initials
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted: detailed tooltip with agency, user, and phone
conditions: For alt-language sessions, fields use alternate values.
system_behavior: SiteProfileHistorySearch returns history for a site.
FillList populates SiteProfileHistory objects from database.
content_gaps: No details on UserControl UI interaction beyond data binding.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents a document attached to an email popup, storing file metadata and supporting search and deletion operations.
purpose: To manage email-related document attachments including metadata, search, and file deletion.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Invoke Search with DataInfo string
Parse and populate list of EmailPopupDocument objects

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Invoke Delete with DataInfo and ID
Deletes file and containing folder if possible
Returns updated DataInfo

business_rules: File deletion and folder deletion should handle exceptions.
system_behavior: Search parses DataInfo to build EmailPopupDocument list.
Delete removes file and folder, updates list.
content_gaps: No details on DataInfo structure population or UI interaction.
